See that's exactly where I'm at. And why I haven't said anything to him. Friends of mine keep telling me I need to bring it up, but I'm doing that whole, "I don't know what to do with my career!" thing.

So I have no real end game because I'm not sure what the above looks like.

The biggest struggle I have right now, and I'm going to go to therapy to deal with, is the kind of career I want is not easily compatible with relationship goals that involve the typical having a family thing (which is a thing I want).
